book.title: Down the Rabbit Hole: Curious Adventures and Cautionary Tales of a Former Playboy Bunny
book.description: A former girlfriend of Hugh Hefner describes how her years inside the Playboy Mansion went from a fairytale of A-list celebrity parties to an oppressive regime of strict rules, scheduled sex, and a total loss of identity, so much so that she even contemplated suicide.
